# SpriteParticleRenderer

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Particles` · record

```csharp
public sealed record SpriteParticleRenderer : ParticleRenderer
```

Types: [`ParticleRenderer`](ParticleRenderer.md)

Draws each particle as a texture, a whole texture or an atlas region, through the toolkit's trim-aware [`SpriteBatchExtensions.Draw`](SpriteBatchExtensions.md#draw). Create one with [`ParticleRenderer.Sprite`](ParticleRenderer.md#sprite) or [`ParticleRenderer.AnyOf`](ParticleRenderer.md#anyof).

## Remarks

A solid particle (confetti, sparks, rain) is a white texture tinted by the particle's color: `Sprite(white) with { Size = new(15, 25) }` draws 15×25 confetti. Use a white atlas region of a few pixels with padding: a tiny region stretched large samples its neighbors unless the atlas pads or extrudes it.

## Properties

### Pivot

```csharp
public Vector2 Pivot { get; init; }
```

Where the texture is placed, and what it scales and rotates around, from (0, 0) at its top left to (1, 1) at its bottom right. Relative, since one renderer can draw textures of different sizes.

### Size

```csharp
public Vector2? Size { get; init; }
```

The size a particle draws at before its scale; null for the texture's logical (untrimmed) size.

### Textures

```csharp

```

Types: [`ITextureSource`](ITextureSource.md)

The textures; each particle draws the one its [`Particle.Variant`](Particle.md#variant) picks.

### Draw

```csharp

```

Types: [`SpriteBatch`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteBatch.md), [`ParticleDrawState`](ParticleDrawState.md)

Draws an effect's live particles, oldest first, into the caller's batch. Fully transparent particles are left out.
